article.title: Review by State Commission in certain cases.
article.content: The State Commission shall have the power to review any of the order passed by it if there is an error apparent on the face of the record, either of its own motion or on an application made by any of the parties within thirty days of such order.
article.html:
50Review by State Commission in certain cases.

Section 50 · Chapter IV · page 25 of the Act

The State Commission shall have the power to review any of the order passed by it if there is an error apparent on the face of the record, either of its own motion or on an application made by any of the parties within thirty days of such order.
